description: This file provides utility functions for parsing command-line arguments and environment variables, including functions for consuming and applying flags for various data types such as string, integer, float, and boolean. It exports these functions for use in other modules.

methods.name: readEnvNumber
methods.description: Reads a number from an environment variable, trims whitespace, and returns null if not set or not a finite number.

methods.name: consumeStringFlag
methods.description: Checks if the current argument matches a flag and, if so, returns the next index and the string value.

methods.name: consumeStringListFlag
methods.description: Checks if the current argument matches a flag and, if so, returns the next index and a string value if valid.

methods.name: consumeIntFlag
methods.description: Checks if the current argument matches a flag and, if so, parses the next argument as an integer with optional constraints.

methods.name: consumeFloatFlag
methods.description: Checks if the current argument matches a flag and, if so, parses the next argument as a float with optional constraints.

methods.name: stringFlag
methods.description: Creates a configuration for consuming a string flag and applying its value to a target object.

methods.name: stringListFlag
methods.description: Creates a configuration for consuming a string list flag and appending its value to a target array.

methods.name: intFlag
methods.description: Creates a configuration for consuming an integer flag with optional range validation and applying it to a target object.

methods.name: floatFlag
methods.description: Creates a configuration for consuming a float flag with optional range validation and applying it to a target object.

methods.name: booleanFlag
methods.description: Creates a configuration for consuming a boolean flag that sets a key to true (or specified value).

methods.name: parseFlagArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments according to specified flag configurations, applying them to the provided args object, handling unknown options based on settings.
